macro_cross_check.verdict: PROTEIN GAP EXCEEDS THE 15% INSTRUMENT AND IS EXPLAINED, NOT A PORTION ERROR. The main protein is weight-anchored (1 lb printed; our only drift is -1.8% quantization), so no each-weight assumption exists to be wrong. Rebuilding OUR EXACT line set with USDA dry SPANISH chorizo (455 cal / 24.1 P / 38.3 F / 1.9 C per 100 g) in place of the fresh Mexican Cacique row reproduces the source's published figures almost exactly: 615.6 cal (+0.6%), 32.2 P (-2.4%), 46.4 F (+0.9%), ~15.9 C (-6%). Their nutrition plugin booked dry-cured Spanish chorizo for the string 'chorizo sausage'; the dish as written (browned in a skillet, Mexican breakfast casserole) uses fresh Mexican chorizo, which is the Cacique label row and the product the board prices. Our lower calories and protein are the honest fresh-chorizo build. Southwest documented-divergence precedent; QA should accept this knowingly rather than 'fix' a portion.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 534.7 cal in [400, 650] PASS with 115 cal of headroom; carbs 17.4 g <= 35 PASS. The +7.1% quantization drifts sit on sub-50-cal vegetable lines and move the serving by under 8 cal combined.

loud_flags: Protein cross-check gap -17.9% is OUTSIDE the 15% instrument; kept because the identical-basis reconstruction above pins the entire gap on the source's Spanish-vs-Mexican chorizo database mismatch (all four macros reconcile within 6% on their basis). If QA disagrees with that reading, the line to re-examine is the chorizo row, not the portion.

Butter for greasing the 9x13 dish appears only in the source's instructions, never in its ingredient list (extractor concern); not booked - a greasing film is sub-10-cal per serving and the printed list governs (rule 0, transcribed as printed).
Source's stated total time excludes its own 6-hour refrigeration step (extractor concern, cosmetic - for the writer).

Seasoned chorizo priced as plain ground pork is a product-concept stretch of exactly the kind rule 1 rejects; flagged for the registrar / match-soundness gate to consider repointing the row's bid to mexican-chorizo-fresh. Standing wiring left unchanged by this lane.
